Ariel — thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is our draft benchmarking plan for the MAP section on performance evaluation (benchmark-plan-v1.pdf). High level ask: we want to agree on workload definition, success criteria (SLOs), and the test window so we can include concrete numbers in the MAP and hit your close timeline.

Proposed scope (summary):
- Targets to measure: TTFT (time to first token), per-token latency, end-to-end response latency (p50/p95), throughput (req/s) at target concurrency, error rate.
- Two test profiles: production-like steady-state and peak-burst (spiky concurrency).
- Test harness: controlled load generator + our inference harness that collects KV cache/TTFT metrics.
- Acceptance: 3 independent runs, p95 latency within agreed SLOs and <0.5% error rate.

Can you confirm the focal model (you mentioned checkout personalization model v2), expected request size distribution, and preferred test windows (we have capacity Wed/Thu next week)? If you want any changes to targets before we propose explicit SLO numbers, say so and we’ll update.

Jordan

- Error budget: <= 0.5% failed requests.

Quick feasibility notes and proposed SLO mapping. I validated locally against a staging replica of checkout-personalization-v2 and sketched the runbook.

Instrumentation / harness:
- Use our internal loader that records TTFT from socket accept to first token emission and per-token latency from kernel timing hooks. Expose metrics to Prometheus + export to CSV for the MAP artifact.
- Test runner will execute 3 independent runs per profile; each run collects p50/p95/p99 latency, TTFT p50/p95, throughput (req/s), CPU/GPU util, and error rate.
- For caching scenarios: run with KV cache cold (no prefix cache), warm, and warm+prefetch.

Proposed SLOs (MAP-ready numbers we can commit to if runs pass):
- TTFT (p50) <= 120 ms, TTFT (p95) <= 350 ms
- Response latency (<=150 tokens): p50 <= 110 ms, p95 <= 600 ms, p99 <= 900 ms
- Sustained throughput (steady-state profile): >= 350 req/s with <0.5% errors
- Peak-burst throughput handled without SLA violation: system must drop into graceful fallback (lower-fidelity model variant) only if token latency p95 > 1s for more than 2 minutes. Fallbacks and counts to be recorded.

Acceptance criteria for MAP: all primary SLOs met across 3 runs for at least one config (preferred: KV warm); no single run has >0.5% HTTP 5xx; observed drift across runs <= 10% for p95 latency.

Data/requests: use Nova sample queries (they'll provide). We will run with and without KV caching to show delta. Output artifacts: consolidated CSV, annotated Grafana snapshot, run-results-template.xlsx filled, short summary slide (1 pager).

I’ll prepare the run script and post the runner to the shared drive tonight.

Marcus
